                                        Core Values:
     1. Integrity: Acting in accordance with the highest academic, professional and ethical
     standards is a priority for one and all representing the educational institution.
     2. Responsibility: We are aware that our moves influence the world around us and based on
     that apprehension, we make the conscious choice to take actions to improve our
     community and the lives of each and everyone around us.
     3. Diversity and Inclusion: Institution respects and appreciates differences in socio-
     economic background, education, ethnicity, colour, gender, age, caste, race, religion,
     physical abilities etc. among individuals. We share environment where everyone has equal
     opportunity to contribute ideas.
     4. Excellence: We strive for excellence in all our endeavours as individuals, an institution,
     and a leader in higher education.
     5. Teamwork: We understand that team values allow us to perform our role effectively and
     contribute to Institution's success.
     6. Transparency: We believe in accessibility, compliance, communication and
     accountability.
     7. Environmental Sustainability: We value adopting practices for minimising ourimpact on
     the environment to the benefit of a more sustainable future for posterity.

                                                FROM PRINCIPAL DESK
    Dear Students,
    I extend a warm welcome to each of you who seek to acquire knowledge and
    contribute to the betterment of society and our nation by joining us here at Dispur
    College. Situated in the heart of Assam's capital, our aim is to foster the holistic
    development of every student, empowering them to confidently navigate their
    future endeavors and contribute meaningfully to society. We recognize that the
    success of our institution hinges not on the efforts of one individual, but on the
    collective contributions of our entire community.
    Dispur College, established in 1978, boasts of 12 academic departments in both Arts
    and Commerce streams, along with highly efficient professional departments in
    BBA & BCA, with an enrollment of around 2500 students. An ISO certified college
    with SDG Accord, Dispur College has also been able to occupy Second Rank in the
    state level and Sixth Position in the entire Eastern India in Arts Stream in a Survey
    conducted by a Magazine of National Repute “The Open” in 2022.
          As a result of our significant contributions in academic excellence, cultural enrichment, community engagement, and sustainable
    development, Dispur College was awarded an ‘A’ Grade in the NAAC Assessment held in November 2024. This recognition is a testament to
    the tireless efforts of our faculty, staff, students, and all stakeholders who have together propelled our institution towards new heights.
    We are dedicated to addressing the various challenges that students may encounter during their educational journey, and we are
    committed to implementing necessary measures to ensure your success and individual growth. Our campus life celebrates the rich folk
    culture of our region through art, dance, and creative expressions, fostering an environment that honors tradition and cultural heritage.
    At Dispur College, we understand the importance of holistic development. Alongside our rigorous academic curriculum, students will be
    encouraged to access a wide range of extracurricular opportunities, including clubs, sports, and cultural activities. From participating in
    initiatives like NCC, NSS, Scouts & Guides to showcasing their talents in various competitions, our students are empowered to explore
    their passions and enhance their skills beyond the classroom.
       Our college is proud to have students who have excelled in state and national sports, cultural, and extracurricular activities, bringing
    glory not only to our college but also to our state. For instance, 8 students from our institution were selected to represent the State in the
    National Wood ball Championship help in Nagpur from 22nd to 26th March, 2025. The team won 4 gold, 3 silver and 3 bronze medals in the
    tournament Moreover, our football team also won the Inter District and Inter College Mahavir Lachit Cup Football Championship held at
    Gauhati University.
    Furthermore, our dedication to cultural excellence is evident in our accolades at events such as the Assam Book Fair, where we won Best
    Performance Award for Orchestra Group for 2024-25 or the Assam Saras Mela where our Bihu Dance Group won the 1st Prize in Folk
    (Group Dance Category)
    Academically, our college has achieved remarkable results, with the state's highest pass percentage in commerce in HS results and 100%
    pass rates in both arts and commerce degree courses, with 90% achieving first class. Furthermore, we have attained a 95.33% pass rate in
    HS commerce, and a 87.38% pass rate in HS arts. We take pride in nurturing a gender-equitable and inclusive environment, where every
    student has the opportunity to thrive. Facilities such as separate washrooms for transgender students, seat reservations, and free
    admission for needy transgender students, along with initiatives like the Gender Champion Program, demonstrate our commitment to
    fostering inclusivity.
    In line with our commitment to sustainability, Dispur College is a tobacco-free and plastic-free zone, promoting environmental
    consciousness among our students and staff.
    Our institution also prioritizes intellectual enrichment through a myriad of seminars and workshops. Over the past five years, we have
    hosted more than 120 seminars and workshops, both nationally and internationally, providing invaluable exposure to our students.
    Events like the South East Asian Cultural Confluence, South East Asian Cultural Conclave, and the ICSSR Sponsored International Seminar
    have been attended by foreign delegates, enriching our students' learning experiences.
    Additionally, Dispur College has embarked on a journey of literary contribution, having recently published around 12 books. These
    publications not only benefit our students but also contribute to the broader societal discourse.
    In alignment with the National Education Policy 2020, Dispur College has already introduced Four-Year degree courses from last academic
    year. Additionally, we offer a range of 30 certificate courses aimed at enhancing your skills and employability. We firmly believe that
    knowledge and skill must go hand in hand, empowering our students to excel in their chosen paths. We offer extensive opportunities for
    skill development and employment through our Institution Innovation Council (IIC), which collaborates with NSDC & IIE, Guwahati.
    I invite each of you to become part of our esteemed institution and embark on a journey of self-discovery and transformation. As
    Abraham Lincoln said, "The best way to predict your future is to create it," we remain steadfast in our commitment to nurturing fearless,
    enlightened minds who will lead our nation towards progress and prosperity.

                                        The Inception:
    With the shift of the capital of Assam from Shillong to Dispur, there emerged a huge demand
    for higher education in the adjacent areas of the new capital which led to the establishment
    of Dispur College in the year 1978, with Sri Ghana Kanta Chetia Phukan as its founder
    Principal. The classes were started with the Arts Stream at Gopal Boro Govt. Higher
    Secondary School in the evening shift only. During the tenure of Principal Dr.Reba Kanta
    Hazarika,the college shifted to its present premises in 1987, at the foothill of Narakasur Hill
    near Ganeshguri Chariali, Dispur, in the heart of Guwahati City. The evening shift was
    discontinued and the classes were transposed to day shifts. The Arts Stream was
    provincialized w.e.f. 1st April, 1992. The College was recognized by the UGC U/S 2F and 12B in
    1995-96. From the academic session 1991-92, the Commerce Stream (HS) was introduced and
    in the year 1994-95, an undergraduate course (B. Com) was introduced in morning shifts. The
    Commerce Stream was provincialized w.e.f. 1st January, 2013. Due to changing needs and
    demand for professional education, the college introduced BBA and BCA from the session
    2007-08 and was approved by the AICTE in 2024. The College also provides a platform for
    open learning via the K.K. Handiqui State Open University and Centre for Distance & Open
    Education, Gauhati University.

From the Academic Session, 2023-24, Dispur College has implemented the FYUGP (Four Years Under Graduate
Programme) in Arts and Commerce under Gauhati University which is based on the National Education Policy
(NEP) 2020. The FYUGP at GU is designed to offer two types of Bachelors’ Degrees to the students at the end of the
successful completion of the programme- (i) Bachelor’s Degree in a Stream and (ii) Bachelor’s Degree in a Discipline.
The word Stream here refers to Arts, Science, Commerce and Management. In case of a degree in a stream, the
student studies a multitude of different subjects, usually mixing different disciplines, which leads to a truly
multidisciplinary degree. While in case of a degree in a discipline, the student is confined to a certain set of
disciplines.
                                                      Admission:
                                 Admission to the FYUGP shall be done as below:
       Eligibility
     a. A student who has passed 12th standard or equivalent examination in any stream from a recognized
     institution.
     b. Admission to the FYUGP will be based on the preference of major.
     c. Admission to a Programme or Major will be subject to availability of the subject and capacity of a
     college/department.
     d. No student shall be eligible for admission to a Programme in any discipline under the FYUGP UNLESS she/he
     fulfills the pre-requisites of courses as fixed by the university.
                                            2. Progression and exits
          The progression and exits during the whole course structure is given below.
       (a) After 1 Year
     One can exit just after one-year. In this case, the student will have to complete one extra Vocational / Skill course
     (Exit Course) of 4 credits and can exit the programme. The student will get a Certificate. The minimum total
     credit requirements are 44 (and 4 credit extra for the exit Vocational / Skill course).
        (b) After 2 Years
     One can exit the programme after two-year course as well. In this case, the student will have to complete one
     extra Vocational / Skill course of 4 credits and can exit the programme. The student will get a Diploma. The
     minimum total credit requirements are 84 (and 4 credits extra for the exit Vocational / Skill course).

       (c) After 3 Years
     If a student completes 3 years, s/he can exit the programme. In this case the student will get a Bachelor’s Degree.
     The minimum total credit requirements is 120.

        (d) After 4 Years
 After completion of 4 years, the student gets either a Bachelor’s Degree (Honours) or a Bachelor’s Degree
 (Honours) with Research. The minimum total credit requirements is 160.
 It should be noted that any certificate / diploma / degree is awarded only if the student clears (i.e. passes) all the
 required courses (papers) till that point of time.
                  However, a student can complete his FYUGP within a maximum period of 7 years.

                               3. Student Mobility : Multiple exits and entries
 The FYUGP allows students to have multiple exits and entries. That is a student can exit the programme,
 say after one year and then again can enter the institution as per the policy of Inter-institutional mobility
 Programme at a later time and can continue the programme from where s/he left. This process can be
 executed multiple times.
                                          Procedures for Lateral exit
  (a) A student will get a certificate / diploma / degree on exit from the GU-FYUGP (depending on in which
  year the student exits), only when the student passes in all the minimum compulsory courses at that
  point of time.
 (b) After an exit, either after Year 1 or 2, the student can seek an entry only into the same programme to which
 the student was admitted.
 (c) When a student exits the GU-FYUGP after 3 years with a Bachelor’s Degree, she/he cannot seek re-
 entry into the programme at the fourth year, rather he/she will need to take admission into the Master’s
 programme at the first year.
 (d) As the contents (syllabi) of all the courses are subject to modification from time, when a student enters
 into the programme after an earlier exit, the contents of all courses will be what is as per the syllabi at the
 current point of time.

                                       Procedures for Lateral Entry
The GU-FYUGP allows a student for inter-institutional mobility, both for incoming and outgoing students. For this,
GU will take into account the credits a student has in his / her ABC.
            For an incoming student, the following should be observed:
     (a) The entry is subject to availability of seats in the concerned discipline.
     (b) The student need to fulfil all the academic prerequisites of the concerned discipline.
     (c) Gauhati University will award a degree to a student, only when the student will have completed 60% of the
     credits for core courses from GU.
                          ABC (Academic Bank of Credits) & SAMARTH-e-Gov Suite

 for exams, assessment & evaluation, ID generation, etc. ) are conducted via SAMARTH-e-Gov Suite and linked to
 ABC via the APAAR ID.
  The GU-FYUGP is directly connected to the ABC (Academic Bank of Credit) as notified by the UGC. All credits a
student earn at the end of an examination in GU-FYUGP, will be deposited in the ABC by the university.
  As such it is mandatory that a student under GU-FYUGP register for the ABC and generate a APAAR ID as
 notified by the regulatory agencies.

                              48 ASSAM NAVAL UNIT NCC, DISPUR COLLEGE:
The 48 Assam Naval Unit NCC, Dispur College acts as a gateway for students wishing to join the service of the
Motherland. The NCC provides various opportunities at personality and leadership development of its enrolled
cadets through inculcation of discipline gained from the regimented way of life that the NCC provides. Cadets can
attend various International and National-level camps and competitions including Overseas Deployment Camp
and Republic Day Camp at locations such as Seychelles, Mauritius, Maldives, and various campsites in India.
Cadets are also provided with national scholarships such as Cadet Welfare Society (CWS) aimed at academic
development of the cadets. Furthermore, the Bir Chilarai Award is one of the prestigious awards that cadets yearn
to achieve. In the first year, cadets are eligible to attend 'B' certificate and in the second year after attending two
national camps, cadets are eligible for 'C' certificate exam. 'C' certificate holders can get appointment through
special entry scheme in the Indian Armed Forces as well as other paramilitary forces of India without written
examination of the UPSC. There is no admission fee for joining NCC.
